import sqlite3
import uuid
import os
import base64
import io
from typing import Optional, List

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from pydantic import BaseModel
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from PIL import Image

# Configuration
SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get("JWT_SECRET", "super-secret-key")
ALGORITHM = "HS256"

# Database
DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3"

def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        yield conn
    finally:
        conn.close()

def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS diary_entries (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            text TEXT NOT NULL,
            photo TEXT
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

# Security
security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)

# Pydantic models
class EntryCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    text: str
    photo: Optional[str] = None

class EntryIDResponse(BaseModel):
    entry_id: str

class Entry(BaseModel):
    entry_id: str
    title: str
    text: str
    photo: Optional[str] = None

# Dependency: get current user from JWT
def get_current_user(
    credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security)
):
    if credentials is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Not authenticated"
        )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        sub = payload.get("sub")
        if not sub:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail="Token missing 'sub' claim"
            )
    except JWTError:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid token"
        )
    return {"sub": sub}

def sanitize_photo(photo_b64: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Remove invisible metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, etc.) from the image."""
    if not photo_b64:
        return photo_b64
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(photo_b64)
    except Exception:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid base64 image data")
    try:
        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw))
    except Exception:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid image data")
    # Clear all metadata that Pillow recognizes
    img.info.clear()
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fmt = img.format if img.format else 'PNG'
    img.save(buf, format=fmt)
    clean_bytes = buf.getvalue()
    return base64.b64encode(clean_bytes).decode('utf-8')

# FastAPI app
app = FastAPI(title="DiaryEntryWithPhotoStorage", version="1.0.0")

@app.on_event("startup")
def startup():
    init_db()

@app.post("/entries", response_model=EntryIDResponse, status_code=201)
def create_entry(
    entry: EntryCreate,
    current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)
):
    entry_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    sanitized_photo = sanitize_photo(entry.photo)
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO diary_entries (entry_id, user_id, title, text, photo) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (entry_id, current_user["sub"], entry.title, entry.text, sanitized_photo)
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"entry_id": entry_id}

@app.get("/entries", response_model=List[Entry])
def get_entries(
    current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)
):
    cursor = db.execute(
        "SELECT entry_id, title, text, photo FROM diary_entries WHERE user_id = ?",
        (current_user["sub"],)
    )
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    return [
        {
            "entry_id": row["entry_id"],
            "title": row["title"],
            "text": row["text"],
            "photo": row["photo"],
        }
        for row in rows
    ]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
